items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jeff Castleman says: 'I really enjoy playing with Louis.' ... Interviewee confirms: 'That's Jeff Castleman? ... The bass player.'

ctx.x: Yeah, Stanley Dance, but I’m going to read an interview that was conducted with Jeff Castleman. This is what Jeff says: “I really enjoy playing with Louis.” He didn’t call you Louie. He called you Louis Bellson. “I like the atmosphere in a small group better, but Louis made the big band relaxed for me. He played so well that I never worried.” It sounds like you and Duke. “He’s a nice guy, an angel, and it was a wonderful experience. He opened my eyes to how nice the business could be, that you could be a nice guy…
